name: BACH_0321_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (62%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Resampled frozen section is flagged unreliable, cannot exclude InSitu (28%) [F1], and defers margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 62%, InSitu 28%, Normal 7%, Invasive 3% | Leans Benign; InSitu plausible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage, alpha 0.10) | Cannot separate Benign, InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 100th OOD percentile [F6] | Suspect resampled frozen section |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top classes differ) | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign [F5] (5/5 Normal, 82%–84%) | Nearest neighbors are Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.21, contribution -0.71) lowers risk [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Above-typical (0.90), descriptive; 8/20 spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.09, contribution -0.28); 0/20 check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · High (1.00, contribution -0.21); 20/20 spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.001, CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Resampled frozen-section artifact (30% reliability, 100th OOD percentile) masks InSitu (28%) or mimics atypia.
- Tissue is Normal, matching 5/5 similar cases (82%–84% similarity), while CONCH and MUSK disagree.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Inspect highest-risk tiles for invasion, pleomorphism (region 0), and benign stroma.
2. **Regions 1, 7, 10**: Check ducts and tubules for in situ atypia; consider deeper levels.
3. **Region 6**: Check lymphocytic infiltrate; consider recut H&E and defer margins to permanent sections.
